Addl. Chief Secy. ... on 11 March, 2024

Author: Vivek Chaudhary
Bench: Vivek Chaudhary
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:21255-Db
Court No. - 2

Petitioner :- Sumant Kumar Upadhyay And Another
Respondent :- State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. Revenue Deptt. Civil Secrt. Lko.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
And
Counsel for Petitioner :- Dinesh Kumar Tiwari
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Vivek Chaudhary,J.
Hon'ble Om Prakash Shukla,J.
1.

Heard learned Counsel for the petitioners and learned Standing Counsel for the State-respondents.
2. Petitioners have approached this Court with the following main prayers :-
"I. Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of Mandamus commanding the opposite party no.2 and 3 to compensate the petitioners for land acquisition of the Sumant Kumar Upadhyay And Another vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. ...

entities.text: Sumant Kumar Upadhyay And Another vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: land of petitioner bearing land Khata No.121 Gata No.526 area 0.310 situated at Village and Pargana Pahadpur, Tehsil Gauriganj, District Amethi under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, within stipulated period of time as deem fit by this Hon'ble Court (contained as Annexure No.1), in the interest of justice.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
II. Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of Mandamus commanding the Opposite Parties particularly Opposite Party No.2 and 3 to decide the representation dated 12.01.2024 of the petitioners, within a stipulated period of time, (contained as Annexure No.4), in the interest of justice."
3.
Standing Counsel, on the basis of instructions, submits that construction is not being carried out on the aforementioned gata, but the same is being carried out on adjacent government gata.

4. After arguing at some length, learned Counsel for the petitioners submits that grievance of the petitioners would be substantially met in case Gata No.526 area 0.310 situated at Village and Pargana Pahadpur, Tehsil Gauriganj, District Amethi be demarcated under Section 24 of the U.P.
Revenue Code, 2006 in accordance with law on the basis of a proper survey report.
5. Learned Standing Counsel for the State-respondents has no objection to the same.

6. In the given circumstances, the petitioners are permitted to move an application under Section 24 of the U.P. Revenue Code, 2006 before Sub-Divisional Magistrate concerned within a period of two weeks, who shall proceed and decide the said application on the basis of proper survey report after hearing all the parties concerned within a period of two months from the date a certified copy of this order along with the application is placed before him.
7. With the aforesaid direction, this petition is disposed of.
(Om Prakash Shukla, J.) (Vivek Chaudhary, J.) Order Date :- 11.3.2024
